requirements.title: Work completion separated from product acceptance
requirements.statement: External/AgilePlus work state may be linked as context, but completion cannot itself satisfy product obligations without admissible re-verification.
requirements.positive: Mark linked work complete while required product proof is absent; assessment remains non-green. Add qualifying evidence; reassessment may change.
requirements.negative: Done/merged/closed work directly flipping a product requirement to satisfied is prohibited.

requirements.title: Represent external work without owning its lifecycle
requirements.statement: Tracera can link externally managed work while remaining independent of and not duplicating that system's execution state machine.
requirements.positive: Link/retrieve an external work reference without creating native duplicate execution transitions.
requirements.negative: External work-system outage must not corrupt accepted product truth.

requirements.title: Core operation without optional cloud integrations
requirements.statement: Canonical identity, intent, graph, observations, and assessment remain usable when optional graph/cache/object/analytics/ML integrations are disabled.
requirements.positive: Start a supported local configuration without optional credentials and complete the core product assessment journey.
requirements.negative: Missing optional integration config must not block core local product use.

requirements.title: Supported storage semantic parity
requirements.statement: Supported SQLite and PostgreSQL stores preserve the same canonical product/graph semantics for supported operations.
requirements.positive: Run one canonical CRUD/query fixture against both stores and compare observable semantics modulo backend metadata.
requirements.negative: Backend selection must not change product status or relation meaning.

requirements.title: Migration preserves canonical state
requirements.statement: Schema migration has a defined compatibility/recovery path and does not silently lose product identities, relations, or evidence.
requirements.positive: Migrate a populated fixture and verify canonical data/relations plus documented rollback/restore or forward recovery.
requirements.negative: Structural migration success while orphaning trace/evidence identities is failure.

requirements.title: Mutation authority enforced
requirements.statement: Untrusted content or unauthenticated callers cannot obtain product/graph mutation authority; read, propose, and mutate authority remain distinguishable.
requirements.positive: Attempt unauthorized mutation and receive rejection while allowed read/proposal behavior remains available.
requirements.negative: Text inside an ingested artifact must not grant itself mutation authority.

requirements.title: Bounded truthful interface errors
requirements.statement: Public interfaces distinguish invalid input, unauthorized action, missing entity, dependency failure, and internal failure enough for callers not to infer success.
requirements.positive: Exercise representative failures and receive non-success machine-readable classes with bounded safe detail.
requirements.negative: Success payloads hiding errors or secret/stack leakage are prohibited.

requirements.title: Verification evidence binds exact candidate and expectation
requirements.statement: Product proof identifies exact product/baseline/expectation and candidate artifact/source revision plus verifier context.
requirements.positive: Evidence for build A is recorded with candidate identity and cannot silently validate changed build B.
requirements.negative: A generic CI green badge without candidate/baseline binding is insufficient product proof.

requirements.title: Required collector failure cannot yield green
requirements.statement: Failure/unavailability of a required evidence collector produces unknown, inconclusive, or blocked semantics rather than satisfied.
requirements.positive: Make a required collector fail before evidence production and observe non-green assessment with failure explanation.
requirements.negative: Collector error treated as empty-success or skipped-success is prohibited.

requirements.title: Retention/redaction preserves referential integrity
requirements.statement: When governed payloads are redacted/retained, stable identities and necessary provenance links remain sufficient to explain historical state without exposing removed content.
requirements.positive: Redact a governed payload and retain resolvable tombstoned/redacted identity links.
requirements.negative: Deletion that silently breaks assessment/trace history is prohibited.
